cards.prompt: Berapa kira-kira rentang panjang gelombang radiasi ultraviolet?
Kacamata hitam super murah di pinggir jalan biasanya hanya plastik dengan lapisan warna tipis, bukan perlindungan UV sungguhan.
cards.answer: Benar: yang sangat murah umumnya cuma plastik dengan lapisan tint tipis.

cards.prompt: Why do polarized lenses cut glare from a lake surface?
options: Lake glare is horizontally polarized and the filter passes only vertical light
They just make the lens darker
cards.answer: Lake glare is horizontally polarized, and the filter only lets vertically polarized light pass.

cards.prompt: Which two tint colors are mentioned, and what does each do?
cards.answer: Gray tints protect from glare; yellow tints strongly reduce blue light.

cards.prompt: The eye absorbs all UV-B and most UV-A, and over time this can lead to ____.
Name four of the technologies used to make sunglasses.
cards.answer: Any four of: tinting, polarization, photochromic lenses, mirroring, anti-reflective coating, UV coating.

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: why can you barely see below the surface of a lake in bright sun, and how do polarized glasses help?
cards.answer: Sunlight bouncing off the water gets squished into a flat, horizontal wave that glares in your eyes. Polarized glasses only let up-and-down waves through, so the glare is blocked and you can see better.

cards.prompt: A friend buys a very dark pair for 5 dollars and says dark lenses mean UV protection. Why is that risky?
cards.answer: Darkness is only tint; without UV coating, dark lenses make pupils open wider and UV can still enter. A good UV coating is what filters UV and prevents cataracts.
cards.explanation: Check for a real UV coating, not just tint.
